# More Cultural Names
# Generated by the More Cultural Names Builder

more_cultural_names_evaluate_and_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_game_rule = no_dynamic_naming }
        reset_state_name = yes
        reset_hub_names = yes
    }
    else = {
        more_cultural_names_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = yes
    }
}

more_cultural_names_assign_state_hub_dynamic_names = {
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_CLUJ ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_CLUJ_state_name_assign = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_CORNOVA ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_CORNOVA_state_name_assign = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_CUPISAN ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_CUPISAN_state_name_assign = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_DEZMIR ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_DEZMIR_state_name_assign = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_FLORESTI ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_FLORESTI_state_name_assign = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_NEWPORT ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_NEWPORT_state_name_assign = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { state_region = { s:STATE_ORADEA ?= this } }
        more_cultural_names_STATE_ORADEA_state_name_assign = yes
    }
}

more_cultural_names_STATE_CLUJ_state_name_assign = {
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:english } }
        set_state_name = STATE_CLUJ_english # Language=English
        set_hub_name = { type = city name = HUB_NAME_STATE_CLUJ_city_english } # Newport
    }
    if = {
        limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:romanian } }
        set_state_name = STATE_CLUJ_romanian # Language=Romanian # Praise the Sun!
        set_hub_name = { type = city name = HUB_NAME_STATE_CLUJ_city_romanian } # Cluj-Napoca
    }
}

        set_state_name = STATE_CORNOVA_romanian # Language=English

    }
